## Preprints

<div class="pub-title">The quadratic growth of Krylov spread complexity in the BTZ black hole</div>

A. Bhattacharya, M. Flory, M. P. Heller, **E. Rizza**, T. Schuhmann  
*Preprint, 2026* · arXiv:2608.09922

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09922)

**My contribution.** I worked primarily on the bulk side: the geometric construction, analytical and numerical implementation, early-time expansion, matching of an infinite tower of extrinsic-curvature invariants to the boundary Krylov series, and large-order/resummation analysis.

## Journal articles

<div class="pub-title">Lorentz symmetry violating Lifshitz-type field theories</div>

**E. Rizza**, D. Zappalà  
*Modern Physics Letters A* **37**, 2250203 (2022) · arXiv:2209.11060

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.11060)

**My contribution.** Perturbative quantum-field-theory analysis of Lifshitz-type models with fermionic degrees of freedom, including ultraviolet power counting, loop corrections, renormalization of scalar and Yukawa-like couplings, asymptotic freedom and stability conditions.

## Ongoing manuscripts and projects

### Rényi second laws for charged AdS black holes

A. Bernamonti, F. Galli, **E. Rizza**  
*Manuscript in preparation*

Charged extension of the Rényi second-law programme to Reissner–Nordström–AdS$_4$ black holes, including merger constraints, extremal configurations, phase structure and radiative-efficiency bounds.

### Analytical reconstruction of Krylov complexity from partition functions

A. Bhattacharya, M. Flory, M. P. Heller, **E. Rizza**, T. Schuhmann  
*In preparation*

Analytical reconstruction of Krylov dynamics using complementary Edgeworth and large-deviation descriptions of the thermal spectral measure.

### Krylov complexity, orthogonal polynomials and the ASEP model

**E. Rizza**, M. Watanabe  
*Project in preparation; author list provisional*

A project connecting Krylov-complexity recurrence structures with stochastic and integrable models, spectral edges and the weakly asymmetric ASEP/JT-KPZ regime.
